preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)
LP burn must be enabled (lpBurnEnabled = true)
Sufficient time must have passed since last LP burn (block.timestamp >= lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, enable trading if not already active, ensure lpBurnEnabled is true, and wait for lpBurnFrequency (default 3600 seconds) to pass. Then execute a sell transaction to the Uniswap pair to trigger the autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens() function in _transfer(). This will burn a percentage of LP tokens (default 0.25%), reducing total supply and increasing the attacker's relative token holdings. Alternatively, call manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens() directly as owner to burn up to 10% of LP tokens after cooldown.
